messages:
arya: Quick heads-up — canary for the paged-attention FlashX rollout on SM90 (cuda 13 driver) shows a consistent tail-latency regression vs SM80. p95 went from ~18ms -> ~28ms on our 2048-token rts loads.

brian: ugh. repro on local bench or only in canary?

arya: Repro'd locally on an L4-like SM90 box we have in staging. Verified with nsight and our runtime traces. Not all models show it — long-context (2k+) decodes most affected.

molly: can you paste the profiler snippet? any kernel mis-selection logs?

arya: pasted below — tracer + runtime selector logs. selector is choosing flashx_paged_variant_v2 on SM90, fallback to triton_fused on some seqs. Notice the KV page-evict count spikes at warmup which correlates with higher kernel launch variance.

```
# runtime selector log (abridged)
[2026-02-14T13:22:01Z] selector: chosen=flashx_paged_variant_v2 (SM90, cuda=13.0)
[2026-02-14T13:22:01Z] kvcache: pages_in_mem=128 pages_evicted=47 evict_policy=age_based
[2026-02-14T13:22:01Z] perf: p95=27.9ms p50=9.2ms qps=120

# nsys sample (kernel timeline summary)
Name                                      Time (ms)
flashx_paged_variant_v2_kernel_main       12.3
flashx_prefetch                          3.1
page_load_copy                            2.8
triton_fused_attention                    8.7
cudaMemcpyAsync                            0.9

# same workload on SM80 with flashx_paged_variant_v1
p95=17.8ms p50=8.5ms qps=140
```

ciara: interesting that triton_fused is faster sometimes — are we seeing more fragmentation on SM90's memory allocator that forces extra memcpy?

arya: allocator stats show higher allocation churn on SM90 driver 13.0. Also saw more small memcpy bursts (~512B-4KB) during KV page loads. Could be driver behavior or our pageprefetch handshake not being happy with SM90 L2/TLB behaviour.

brian: two parallel hypotheses: (1) flashx kernel config tuned for SM80 schedules worse on SM90 (warps/CTA heuristics), (2) CUDA13 changed async copy latency or allocator behavior causing extra synchronization. Need to isolate.

molly: plan: 1) quick microbench comparing flashx_v1/v2 on SM80/SM90 with synthetic KV hit/miss patterns; 2) run selector-bisect to force triton_fused vs flashx and compare tail latencies; 3) capture full nsys timeline and mempool traces. I'll own the perf board ticket. :white_check_mark:

ciara: I'll run microbench matrix. command I used: 
```bash
./bench_attention.sh --kernel flashx_paged_variant_v2 --device sm90 --tokens 2048 --kvhitrate 0.7 --repeats 200
```
Running now, will post numbers in ~30m.

arya: added an extra datapoint — when we force the kernel to use a larger CTA (tile size + warp count) p95 drops back toward SM80 numbers. So kernel launch params matter.

brian: that points to kernel-config autotune being off for newer arch. We should add a quick compile-time branch or runtime heuristic: if arch>=90 prefer larger CTA and prefer prefetch_size=2. But need to test impact on throughput.

molly: also raised concern: batching heuristics. On SM90, our dynamic batching threshold allowed larger concat batches which increases seq-length variance inside a batch and forces more page activity. Could tune dynbatch to prefer narrower batches for long-seq workloads on SM90.

ciara: microbench results (first pass):
- SM90 flashx_v2 p95=28.1ms p50=9.4ms qps=118
- SM90 flashx_v1 p95=26.9ms p50=9.0ms qps=121
- SM90 triton_fused p95=19.2ms p50=8.8ms qps=135
- SM80 flashx_v1 p95=17.6ms p50=8.4ms qps=142
Notes: forcing larger CTA on flashx_v2 -> p95=18.9ms but qps drops ~8%

brian: that is actionable. If flashx_v2 with larger CTA gives parity on tail but costs throughput, we can make runtime choose it for latency-sensitive routes (SLO class) and keep default for throughput routes.

arya: also found KV behavior tweak: switching eviction policy from age_based to lru_windowed reduced page_evicted spikes on SM90. Suggest adding policy override for SM90 in selector config.

molly: re: Triton vs CUDA kernels — do we have a repro that isolates only the kernel codepath (no batching changes)? We should run single-request microbench with fixed batch size 1 and pinned KV resident set so no page I/O. If triton still wins, it's kernel compute perf; otherwise it's memory interaction.

ciara: did that: single-request, KV pinned: triton_fused and flashx_v2 comparable (p95 ~11ms). So it's the memory/page behaviour for longer batched workloads that's driving the delta.

brian: summary of likely root causes: (A) kernel config heuristics not tuned for SM90 (warps/CTA), (B) CUDA13/mempool changes increase small memcpy latency esp during page loads, (C) batching heuristics + page eviction interplay creating more page churn.

molly: next steps (owners):
- brian: add runtime heuristic to prefer larger CTA for flashx on SM90 and add feature flag (canary)
- ciara: complete microbench matrix across cuda 12/13 and SM80/SM90, test eviction policies
- arya: run selector-bisect across canary fleet and mark routes to use triton_fused for latency SLOs until we ship fix
- infra-bot: capture full nsys & mempool traces for repo ticket #INF-4721

brian: I'll open the PR for config change and a light-weight autotune check. Will tag for perf review.

infra-bot: Captured trace bundle INF-4721-2359987654.tar.gz and uploaded to /artifacts/perf/INF-4721/ (owner=molly).

deploy-bot: Canary rollout for flashx_paged_variant_v2 paused (manual hold) — flagged by perf monitor.

molly: adding action items to perf-ops board and scheduling a cross-team sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. ciara — please bring the microbench matrix and selector logs.

ciara: will do. also threw in a quick probe: running cuda12 on SM90 staging drops p95 by ~3ms compared to cuda13. So driver diff seems non-trivial; include that in matrix.

arya: thanks all. main goal: avoid broad rollback by routing latency-sensitive traffic to triton_fused and ship two fixes: kernel-config heuristic + eviction-policy override for SM90.

brian: sounds good. tagging @molly @ciara for followups. :thumbsup:
